label: 1(d)(i)
context:

(d) The denary number 513 cannot be stored accurately as a normalised floating-point number in
this computer system.
answer_text:
One mark for each correct marking point (Max 3)
• Requires 11 bits / more than 10 bits to store (accurately) / reference to
maximum (positive) number that can be stored = 511
• Denary 513 in binary is 1000000001 // Normalised: 0.1000000001
• Results in overflow
explanation_zh: 513=1000000001₂，规格化需0.1000000001×2¹⁰，即符号位加10个有效位；10位尾数只有9个小数位，不能精确保存末位1。
approach_zh: 把513规格化并数尾数位；截断会变512。
pitfalls_zh: 这是尾数精度不足，不应理解为6位指数容不下513。
source_caveat_zh: 疑似评分细则问题（概念表述）：原评分图把513不能精确存储称为overflow，并提maximum positive 511。实际6位指数足以表达量级；不足的是10位尾数的有效位，截断可近似为512，并非该格式整体范围只到511。按MS所要求的“需11位尾数”说明精度问题，原图保持不动。

answer_text:

MP2 Temporary storage of the score being ‘inserted’

MP4 Use of WHILE loop with correct exit clause

MP6 Correct updating of counter variable

YearSize ← 249
FOR Student ← 2 to YearSize
Temp1 ← Score[Student]
Temp2 ← Name[Student,1]
Temp3 ← Name[Student,2]

MP2 Packet switching is used when it is necessary to be able to overcome

MP3 Packet switching is used when it is necessary for the communication
to be more secure.
MP4 Packet switching is used for high volume data transmission.
MP5 Packet switching is used when it isn’t necessary to use all the
bandwidth.
MP6 Specific examples e.g. email, text messages, documents, VOIP etc.
(up to two marks).
explanation_zh: 电子邮件和传送文档/大文件可用packet switching；共享网络无需持续占用整条专线，并可绕过故障链路。

label: 7(b)
answer_text:
One mark per mark point (Max 4)
MP1 Circuit switching uses a dedicated channel to make communication,
whereas packet switching forms data into packets to transmit over a
digital network.
MP2 The dedicated path for circuit switching must be established before
the transfer of data can commence, which is not the case with packet
switching (as it doesn’t require a dedicated path).
MP3 Data in packet switching is split into packets, in circuit switching the
message remains intact.
MP4 All of the transmission in circuit switching follows the same path
whereas different packets in packet switching can take different
routes.
MP5 The message is received in the same order in which it is sent with
circuit switching, but with packet switching, the packets can be
received out of order (for assembly at the destination).
MP6 Circuit switching is implemented at the physical layer while packet
switching is implemented at the network layer.
MP7 Circuit switching uses the whole bandwidth of the channel used,
packet switching can share bandwidth.
MP8 Circuit switching communication ends with an error but packet
switching allows packets to be re-sent.
MP9 Circuit switching is a simpler process than packet switching.
Answer
explanation_zh: 电路交换先建立专用路径，连接期间占用带宽，数据通常按序到达。分组交换把数据拆成 packets，共享链路；各包可能走不同路径、乱序到达，需重组。若采用 TCP 等提供可靠传输的协议，丢失的数据包可单独重传；重传不是分组交换本身必然提供的功能。
approach_zh: 按路径、资源占用、数据分割与到达顺序逐项对比；谈重传时注明它取决于可靠传输协议（如 TCP）。
pitfalls_zh: 不要把可能走不同路径写成每个包必定走不同路；不要说 packet switching 自身保证重传或可靠交付。

DECLARE Location : INTEGER

DECLARE Stored : BOOLEAN
DECLARE Max : INTEGER
Max  100000
Stored  FALSE
Location  1

identifier data type description

Insert integer counter to show current insertion position

answer_text:
One mark per mark point (Max 5)

element
MP2 Temporary variables both initialised to current value of arrays
MP3 Insertion variable initialised
MP4 Correct inner loop criteria
MP5 Elements of both arrays inserted as appropriate

MP7 Temporary values replaced in correct place in arrays
Sample algorithm
FOR Count  1 to 499
Temp1  MemberID[Count]
Temp2  Names[Count]
Insert  Count – 1
WHILE Insert >= 0 AND MemberID[Insert] > Temp1
MemberID[Insert + 1]  MemberID[Insert]
Names[Insert + 1]  Names[Insert]
Insert  Insert – 1

FUNCTION PartSearch(Target : STRING) RETURNS INTEGER
Left  1
Right  1000000
WHILE Left <= Right
Mid  (Left + Right) DIV 2) OR
Mid  DIV(Left + Right, 2)

answer_text:

CONSTANT MaxSize = 40
DECLARE BasePointer : INTEGER
DECLARE TopPointer : INTEGER
DECLARE Stack : ARRAY[1:40] OF REAL
// initialisation of stack
PROCEDURE Initialise()
BasePointer  1
TopPointer  0
ENDPROCEDURE

PROCEDURE Push(NewItem)
IF TopPointer < MaxSize THEN
TopPointer  TopPointer + 1
Stack[TopPointer]  NewItem
ENDIF

One mark for a benefit of packet switching (Max 1)

users
MP7 Possible to overcome failed / faulty / busy lines by re-routing packets
MP8 Individual packets can be resent if lost/damaged

MP10 High rate of data transmission possible

explanation_zh: Circuit switching 的优点是连接建立后专用通道保持至传输结束，适合连续实时通信；packet switching 的优点是分组可共享带宽/绕路重传。
approach_zh: 各写一个与传输机制直接相关的优点。
pitfalls_zh: 避免混用两种技术的特征：专用预留线路属于 circuit switching。

label: 4(b)
answer_text:
One mark per difference (Max 2)
MP1 Circuit switching requires a dedicated line to be connected before the data transfer takes place, in packet
switching, data transfer commences directly/ straight away
MP2 In circuit switching, each data unit knows the entire path address, but in packet switching, each data unit only
knows the final address (routers decide intermediate paths)
MP3 Circuit switching uses the whole bandwidth of the transmission path, but packet switching shares it with other users
// circuit switching uses a constant high bandwidth. Packet switching has variable bandwidth
MP4 In circuit switching each data unit follows the same route, but in packet switching, packets can follow any route
MP5 In circuit switching data arrives in the correct order but in packet switching it has to be reordered
MP6 Data remains intact / a continuous stream in circuit switching but is segmented in packet switching

9 A company requires a digital certificate to ensure the authenticity of its online communications.
Outline the process followed to acquire a digital certificate.
.................................................................................................................................................... [4]
answer_text:
One mark per mark point (Max 4)
MP1 the company generates a public and private key pair locally using a
web browser and an RSA key generator tool, which may be part of
the CA’s web page
MP2 the company requests a digital certificate from a Certificate
Authority (CA)
MP3 the CA responds with its public key and digital certificate,
MP4 … signed with its private key
MP5 the company gathers authentication information e.g. its public key
MP6 … and sends it to the CA signed with the company’s private key and
encrypted with the CA’s public key
MP7 the CA verifies the received information and generates/issues the
digital certificate.
explanation_zh: 公司先生成 public/private key pair，向 Certificate Authority 申请证书并提交身份信息；公司用自身 private key 签名材料并用 CA public key 加密，CA 验证后签发含公司公钥并由 CA 私钥签名的 certificate。
approach_zh: 按密钥生成→申请→身份材料提交→CA 验证/签发顺序解释。
pitfalls_zh: private key 保密；CA certificate 是由 CA 签名的身份—公钥绑定。
